sellers.name: Ross-Simons, Inc.
sellers.headquarters_address: 9 Ross Simons Dr, Cranston, RI 02920-4475, USA
sellers.gram_weight_transparency: Partial — Strong on plain/signet gold bands (exact grams published on Items 571221, 571212, 823796, 964717, 993085); omitted on diamond solitaires.
sellers.return_shipping_terms: Shipping & handling non-refundable; flat $4.95 return label fee may apply; insure package for full invoice value.
sellers.resized_custom_exclusions: Merchandise that has been damaged, altered, or resized by any jeweler other than Ross-Simons CANNOT be returned.
sellers.accepted_payments: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, PayPal (US), Affirm
sellers.wire_transfer_risk_note: No bank wire discount trap; standard major credit cards fully accepted for Fair Credit Billing Act dispute protection.
sellers.checklist_grade: PASS (Top Overall Traditional Value & Weight Disclosure)
flagged_notes: Catalog sells BOTH solid karat gold AND gold-plated/gold-over-sterling items (e.g., Item 241592 '14kt Yellow Gold over Brass')—always verify the Metal spec table line by line.
Found 10kt vs 14kt copy contradiction on Item 251663; always screenshot listing before checkout.

sellers.name: Blue Nile, Inc. (Signet Jewelers)
sellers.gram_weight_transparency: Omitted on standard engagement ring product pages — requires live chat/phone inquiry prior to purchase.
sellers.return_shipping_terms: Free insured return shipping (capped at 2 free returns per customer per year; $150 replacement fee if GIA/diamond report missing).
sellers.resized_custom_exclusions: Engraved rings, custom/special-order designs, and previously resized rings are excluded or non-refundable; live policy now limits one free standard resize to 6 months from purchase (shortened from prior 1-year window).
sellers.accepted_payments: Major Credit Cards, Debit Cards, PayPal, Blue Nile Credit Card, Bank Wire ($1,000+)
sellers.wire_transfer_risk_note: WARNING (CHECKLIST #8): Offers a 1.5% discount on bank wires >= $1,000, which forfeits credit card chargeback protection. Prefer credit card despite the 1.5% spread.
sellers.checklist_grade: CONDITIONAL PASS (Request Gram Weight First; Skip Engraving & Bank Wire)
flagged_notes: Never add free engraving at initial purchase—engraving voids 30-day return eligibility immediately.
Have an independent jeweler verify karat purity via XRF BEFORE utilizing Blue Nile's 1 free resize within 6 months, because resized rings become non-returnable.

sellers.gram_weight_transparency: Omitted online (publishes mm band width & depth, not gram weight).

sellers.resized_custom_exclusions: Previously resized items, custom designs, and final-sale rings CANNOT be returned — weigh & XRF test BEFORE resizing (live US returns page states 1-year free standard resize vs. BBB summary '60 Day Free Resizing').
sellers.accepted_payments: Major Credit Cards (Visa, MC, Amex, Discover), Apple Pay, PayPal, Affirm, Wells Fargo, Bank Wire ($500+)
sellers.wire_transfer_risk_note: WARNING (CHECKLIST #8): Offers 1.5% bank wire discount ($500+; $35 fee on CA/intl wires)—forfeits credit card dispute protection.
sellers.checklist_grade: CONDITIONAL PASS (Check Individual Ring Resize Exclusion & Prong Metal)
flagged_notes: Caught page-level contradiction on Fairmined Solitaire BE1FM0126 (banner says 'Free 1-Year Resizing' while body text says 'resizing is not available for this ring').
BBB complaint records confirm any repair/resizing performed by an outside jeweler voids Brilliant Earth's warranty—use strictly non-destructive XRF + scale check upon arrival.
